SR3E.Senses.Title: Senses
SR3E.Senses.HudTip: Senses — vision mode, ultrasound range, dual-natured
SR3E.Senses.UltrasoundRange: Ultrasound range (m) — house default 50, no book gives one
SR3E.Senses.Perceiving: Perceiving astrally — astral sight replaces the vision mode; ordinary walls still block (SR3 p.172).
SR3E.Senses.Projecting: Projecting — sees and moves through walls; only ward walls stop the astral form (SR3 p.173).
SR3E.Senses.GlassHint: Blocks thermographic vision (house rule — the book is silent).
SR3E.Senses.WardHint: An astral barrier: stops a projecting astral form's sight, glows for astral viewers. Its Force is the visual penalty (SR3 p.173) — a reminder, not applied.
